sentences.en: You may as well overlook his sins and forgive him.
sentences.zh: 你不妨忽视他的罪过并原谅他。

sentences.en: How did you manage to overlook such a glaring error?
sentences.zh: 你怎么会忽略如此明显的错误呢？

sentences.en: The church is on the hill overlooking the city.
sentences.zh: 那座教堂位于俯瞰城市的山上。

senses.zh: 忽视；眺望；从高处能看到的景色
